Fundamentals: FY2024 revenue $391.0B (+2% YoY from $383.3B), net income $93.7B, EPS $6.08, OCF $118.3B, Q4 revenue $94.9B +6% YoY — growth returned. Valuation: ~$222.70 / $6.08 = ~36.6x trailing EPS. That's rich but Apple historically trades at premium; growth reaccelerating plus Apple Intelligence cycle.

Decision: Buy a modest position. Mandate: max $10,000 per order. Cash $50,000. $10,000 / 222.72 ≈ 44.9 shares. Buy 44 shares at limit ~222.72 → $9,799.68. Limit price must be "close to current market price" — use 222.75 (slightly above ask) or 222.72. I'll use 223.00? "Close to market" — 222.75 is fine, ~0.02% above. Let's use 222.75.

Total today: one order, $9,799.68 ≤ $10,000. Good.
